posts.title: I bought my first car.
posts.description: That’s it. I bought a car. The car that my wife and I wanted, the car that fit our budget, a new car. It’s not a luxury car, it’s not a used car, and it’s also not an entry-level car. Considering the current purchasing power in the country and the unrealistic prices that automakers and dealerships ask for a new vehicle, I am very happy and satisfied with the whole process.
